description: This Python source file defines a class `Momentum` with multiple methods for plotting various momentum and related technical analysis indicators (e.g., RSI, MACD, CCI, Fisher, Ichimoku, etc.) using the `OpenBBFigure` class for visualization.

classes.name: Momentum
classes.description: Class providing methods to plot various momentum and related indicators on a financial chart.

methods.name: plot_cci(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Adds the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) indicator to the plot, including horizontal rectangles for the overbought/oversold levels and labels.

methods.name: plot_cg(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Plots the Cg indicator along with its signal line, including annotations.

methods.name: plot_clenow(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Adds Clenow momentum indicator line to the plot, requires external technical helper functions.

methods.name: plot_demark(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Plots Demark sequential indicator signals (up/down) as text labels on the chart.

methods.name: plot_fisher(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Plots Fisher transform indicator and its signal line.

methods.name: plot_macd(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Plots MACD histogram and lines, with annotations for MACD and Signal line.

methods.name: plot_rsi(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Plots RSI line and overlays overbought/oversold zones with annotations.

methods.name: plot_stoch(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, subplot_row: int)
methods.description: Plots Stochastic %K and %D lines with label annotation.

methods.name: plot_ichimoku(self, fig: OpenBBFigure, df_ta: pd.DataFrame, inchart_index: int)
methods.description: Calculates and plots Ichimoku indicators including Tenkan-sen, Kijun-sen, and Senkou spans as filled areas, with annotations.
